notes: The production test profile accepts only chr1-chr22, chrX, chrY and chrM/MT input records.
The representative GFF3/cache keeps one transcript per gene using MANE Select, MANE Plus Clinical, Ensembl canonical, protein-coding, APPRIS, TSL, CCDS, length and transcript-ID precedence.
The representative GFF3/cache excludes alternate, random, patch and unplaced contigs.
The historical data/reference/hg38.fa symlink is not used by the pinned MTB profile.
The transcript cache and the runtime FASTA must both be supplied; the cache does not replace the FASTA for coding consequence and HGVS generation.
The default supplementary directory contains 55 converted .osa2 files covering eight source types.
gnomAD exomes v4.1 and phyloP100way are stored as chr1-22, chrX and chrY shards.
SpliceAI indel was built from a repair copy with the final incomplete BGZF block removed; a fresh licensed BaseSpace source is required for archival completeness.
The positive integration fixture observed alphaMissense, clinvar, dbnsfp, gnomad, phylop, primateAI, revel and spliceAI in one run on 2026-10-22.
